node.title: L1 interior BC floor routes to higher-shell Q
node.statement: For a strict-interior profile d1>=m-k+2, put m'=k-1+d1>m. Every codeword in Paper D's level-m' identity-prefix floor agrees completely on exactly m' points. Its binom(m',m) level-m support witnesses have positive agreement cofactor dividing the complement locator, so all fail the exact-shell gcd guard. Binomial inversion cancels their contribution to Z_m, while each codeword is retained once in Z_m'. Since d1=(m'-k)+1, that true shell is boundary Q. Thus the named base-field support floor is higher-shell Q mass, not an unavoidable L1 exact-interior floor; other guarded interior members remain open.
